senses.en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use.
Not busy and able to meet or help someone.

ex.en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
ex.zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

col: available to everyone｜人人都可获得的
make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

senses.en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional.
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: The average price of these jackets is quite reasonable.
ex.zh: 这些夹克的平均价格相当合理。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
ex.zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开早高峰的车流。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

senses.en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something.
Not at home or at the usual place.

ex.en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
ex.zh: 我打开窗户时，小鸟飞走了。

ex.en: Moving away from crowded cities can improve wellbeing, but may reduce access to employment.
ex.zh: 搬离拥挤的城市可能改善身心健康，但也可能减少就业机会。

tip: away是副词；表示“远离某处”用away from。

senses.en: Extremely bad or unpleasant.

ex.en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，所以我做了个三明治。

ex.en: Residents described the awful conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter safety standards.
ex.zh: 居民描述了过度拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁制定更严格的安全标准。

tip: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

senses.en: a very young child or animal
very young, or intended for babies
treat someone as helpless or needing excessive care

ex.en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
ex.zh: 爸爸轻声唱歌时，宝宝睡着了。

ex.en: Affordable childcare helps parents of young babies return to work without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务有助于婴儿的父母重返工作岗位，而不会给家庭财务带来过大压力。

tip: 复数为babies；baby作动词常含“过度照顾”之意。

senses.en: The rear part of your body or of something else.
Towards the rear, or to a previous place or state.
To support a person, plan, or organization.

ex.en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
ex.zh: 坐了一上午后，我感觉背部僵硬。

ex.en: Local residents are likely to back transport projects that reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 当地居民很可能支持能缓解拥堵并方便就业出行的交通项目。

col: at the back of｜在…的后部
tip: go back表示回去；back作动词可表示支持。

senses.en: The family, education, and experience that shape someone's life
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: Her background in nursing helped her care for Grandpa.
ex.zh: 她的护理经历帮助她照顾爷爷。

ex.en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm.
Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

col: bad for your health｜有害健康
tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex.zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

ex.en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
ex.zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。

col: a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子
tip: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

senses.en: a place where bread and cakes are made or sold

ex.en: The bakery near our house sells warm bread every morning.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的面包店每天早上都卖热乎乎的面包。

ex.en: Small businesses such as bakeries provide local employment and help maintain vibrant neighbourhood shopping areas.
ex.zh: 面包店等小企业提供本地就业岗位，也有助于保持社区商业区的活力。

tip: bakery指店铺或制作场所；烘焙食品用baked goods。

senses.en: A steady position or a suitable mixture of different things
To keep something steady or give competing needs suitable attention
The money remaining in an account or still owed

ex.en: She lost her balance while stepping off the bus.
ex.zh: 她下公交车时失去了平衡。

ex.en: Governments must balance the demand for affordable housing with the need to protect green spaces.
ex.zh: 政府必须兼顾人们对可负担住房的需求和保护绿地的需要。

col: work-life balance｜工作与生活的平衡
tip: 兼顾两者用balance A with B；均衡饮食用balanced。

senses.en: A round object used in games or shaped like one.
A formal social event where people dance.

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
ex.zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。

ex.en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 简单的球类游戏能帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作和日常体育锻炼。

col: a ball of wool｜一团毛线
tip: 球类运动前通常不用冠词，如play football。

senses.en: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas.
A large gas-filled bag carrying people in a basket.

ex.en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
ex.zh: 一只黄色气球飘在生日蛋糕上方。

ex.en: Releasing balloons outdoors can harm wildlife when the rubber fragments fall into rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 在户外放飞气球可能危害野生动物，因为橡胶碎片会落入河流和海洋。

tip: blow up a balloon指吹气球，不是炸毁气球。

senses.en: A long curved fruit with soft flesh and usually yellow skin

ex.en: He peeled a banana and sliced it over his cereal.
ex.zh: 他剥了一根香蕉，切成片放在麦片上。

ex.en: Banana farming provides an important source of income for many families in tropical regions.
ex.zh: 香蕉种植为热带地区的许多家庭提供了重要收入来源。

col: a bunch of bananas｜一串香蕉
tip: 可数名词：一根香蕉是a banana。

senses.en: an organisation that holds money and provides financial services
land along the edge of a river or lake
put money into an account at a bank

ex.en: I went to the bank to open an account.
ex.zh: 我去银行开了一个账户。

ex.en: Banks can support local economic development by offering affordable loans to small businesses and new entrepreneurs.
ex.zh: 银行可以向小企业和初创创业者提供低成本贷款，以支持当地经济发展。

tip: 岸边用on the bank；银行里用at或in the bank。

senses.en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served
a long narrow piece of solid material
to officially prevent someone from entering or doing something

ex.en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
ex.zh: 我们在酒店的酒吧点了鲜榨橙汁。

ex.en: Sports centres should not bar residents from using essential facilities simply because they cannot afford membership fees.
ex.zh: 体育中心不应仅因居民付不起会员费，就禁止他们使用基本设施。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一条巧克力
bar someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事
tip: 表禁止用bar sb from doing；过去式barred。

senses.en: The lowest supporting part or underlying foundation of something.
A place from which people work or organise activities.
To use something as the foundation for a decision or idea.

ex.en: The heavy base keeps the lamp from falling over.
ex.zh: 沉重的底座让灯不易倒下。

ex.en: Governments should base their environmental policies on reliable scientific evidence rather than short-term political interests.
ex.zh: 政府应以可靠的科学证据而非短期政治利益为依据制定环境政策。

tip: base A on B表示“以B为依据建立A”。

senses.en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something.
Having only necessary features, without anything extra.

ex.en: This course teaches basic cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技能。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

senses.en: A container made from woven strips, wire, or similar materials
The hoop and net in basketball, or a score through it

ex.en: I carried a basket of fresh apples into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我提着一篮新鲜苹果走进厨房。

ex.en: Providing reusable shopping baskets can encourage customers to reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bags.
ex.zh: 提供可重复使用的购物篮可以鼓励顾客减少对一次性塑料袋的依赖。

col: a basket of fruit｜一篮水果
tip: a basket of apples指一篮苹果；篮子数量用baskets。

senses.en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops
the large round ball used in this game

ex.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。

ex.en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
ex.zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。

tip: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。

senses.en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water.
A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.

ex.en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
ex.zh: 徒步之后，泡个温水澡让我放松了下来。

ex.en: Taking shorter showers instead of a daily bath can reduce household water consumption significantly.
ex.zh: 用较短时间的淋浴代替每天泡澡，可以显著减少家庭用水量。

tip: 英式常说have a bath；美式常说take a bath。

senses.en: A room with a bath or shower, often including a toilet.
A room containing a toilet, especially in American English.

ex.en: She hung a clean towel beside the bathroom sink.
ex.zh: 她在浴室洗手池旁挂了一条干净毛巾。

ex.en: Installing water-saving fixtures in the bathroom can help households reduce consumption without changing their daily routines.
ex.zh: 在浴室安装节水设备，可以帮助家庭在不改变日常习惯的情况下减少用水。

tip: 美式英语中bathroom也可指没有浴缸的厕所。

senses.en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity.
A large set of similar things, especially tests or questions.

ex.en: The torch needs a new battery before our trip.
ex.zh: 出发旅行前，这只手电筒需要换一节新电池。

ex.en: Improved battery technology could make electric vehicles more affordable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 电池技术的进步可以降低电动汽车的价格，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

col: a battery of tests｜一系列测试
tip: 复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。

senses.en: A fight between armed forces.
A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem.
To struggle hard against someone or something.

ex.en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了某场著名战役中使用的盔甲。

ex.en: The battle against air pollution requires coordinated action from governments, businesses, and individuals across urban areas.
ex.zh: 对抗空气污染需要城市各地的政府、企业和个人协调行动。

col: battle against pollution｜与污染作斗争
battle for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

senses.zh: 是；成为(原形，其人称和时态形式有 am, is, are, was, were,being, been)

senses.en: an area of sand or small stones beside water
to bring a boat onto a shore

ex.en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。

ex.en: Local authorities should protect beaches from plastic waste while ensuring that tourism benefits nearby communities.
ex.zh: 地方政府应保护海滩免受塑料垃圾污染，同时确保旅游业惠及附近社区。

tip: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。

senses.en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility
a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur
to have or display a particular feature or mark

ex.en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
ex.zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。

ex.en: Low-income households often bear the greatest burden when the cost of essential goods rises.
ex.zh: 生活必需品价格上涨时，低收入家庭往往承受最沉重的负担。

tip: 过去式bore；过去分词通常borne；出生用born。

senses.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest.
To hit repeatedly, or move with a regular rhythm.
A regular pulse of sound or movement.

ex.en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐昨天又下棋赢了我。

ex.en: Athletes need consistent training and psychological support to beat their strongest competitors in international events.
ex.zh: 运动员需要持续训练和心理支持，才能在国际赛事中击败最强劲的对手。

tip: 过去式 beat，过去分词 beaten；赢比赛用 win。

senses.en: Very pleasing to see, hear, or experience.

ex.en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
ex.zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。

ex.en: Protecting beautiful natural landscapes can attract visitors while preserving valuable habitats for future generations.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的自然景观既能吸引游客，又能为后代保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 可修饰景色、声音等；比较级用more beautiful。

senses.en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience.
A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.

ex.en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
ex.zh: 我们停下来欣赏湖泊的美景。

ex.en: Protecting the natural beauty of coastal areas can support tourism while preserving valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 保护沿海地区的自然美景既能促进旅游业，也能保全珍贵的野生动物栖息地。

col: the beauty of something｜某事物的妙处
tip: 表示“美”通常不可数；the beauty of也指妙处。

senses.en: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.

ex.en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
ex.zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。

ex.en: Many commuters choose public transport because it is cheaper and produces fewer emissions than driving alone.
ex.zh: 许多通勤者选择公共交通，因为它比独自开车更省钱，排放也更少。

col: because of the weather｜由于天气原因
tip: because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality

ex.en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
ex.zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。

ex.en: Public transport must become more reliable and affordable if cities want residents to drive less frequently.
ex.zh: 如果城市希望居民减少开车，公共交通就必须变得更可靠、更实惠。

col: become increasingly important｜变得日益重要
tip: 变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

senses.en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping
The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake
An area of soil prepared for growing plants

ex.en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，猫蜷缩在我的床上。

ex.en: Maintaining a regular time to go to bed can improve sleep quality and support mental health.
ex.zh: 保持固定的就寝时间可以改善睡眠质量，并有益于心理健康。

tip: go to bed指就寝，不加the；make the bed指铺床。

senses.en: A room used mainly for sleeping.

ex.en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
ex.zh: 我的卧室早晨阳光很充足。

ex.en: Children who share a bedroom may develop cooperation skills, but they also need sufficient privacy as they grow.
ex.zh: 共用卧室的孩子可能会培养合作能力，但随着成长，他们也需要足够的隐私。

tip: 可数名词；a two-bedroom flat指两居室公寓。

senses.en: meat from cattle, eaten as food

ex.en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
ex.zh: 我们把牛肉和胡萝卜、土豆一起慢炖。

ex.en: Reducing beef consumption could lower greenhouse gas emissions because raising cattle requires substantial land and resources.
ex.zh: 减少牛肉消费可能降低温室气体排放，因为养牛需要大量土地和资源。

tip: 表示食物时通常不可数：some beef，不用a beef。

senses.en: Earlier than a particular time or event.
Earlier than the time when something happens.
At an earlier time.

ex.en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
ex.zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。

ex.en: Before introducing new transport policies, local authorities should consult residents about their daily travel needs.
ex.zh: 地方政府在推出新的交通政策之前，应就居民的日常出行需求征求意见。

col: before making a decision｜作决定之前
tip: 时间从句表将来时，before后通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: to start happening or start doing something

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex.zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。

tip: 过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

senses.en: The first part or starting point of something.

ex.en: We missed the beginning of the film yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天错过了电影的开头。

ex.en: The beginning of formal education marks an important stage in a child's social development.
ex.zh: 正规教育的开始标志着儿童社会性发展的一个重要阶段。

col: at the beginning of｜在……开始时
from beginning to end｜从头到尾
tip: at the beginning of后接名词；in the beginning表示起初。

senses.en: the way a person or animal acts
the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions

ex.en: The puppy's calm behavior surprised everyone at the park.
ex.zh: 这只小狗安静的表现让公园里的每个人都很惊讶。

ex.en: Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有实质性机会参与影响其社区的决策，以此鼓励负责任的行为。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

senses.en: at or towards the back of someone or something
at the back or making less progress than expected
responsible for causing or supporting something

ex.en: Your umbrella is behind the door in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 你的伞在厨房的门后面。

ex.en: Students who fall behind at school may benefit from additional support rather than stricter discipline.
ex.zh: 在学校学习落后的学生可能更需要额外的支持，而非更严格的纪律。

tip: behind可作介词或副词；fall behind表示落后。

senses.en: a living creature, especially a person
existence or the essential nature of a person or thing

ex.en: Every living being in this pond needs clean water.
ex.zh: 这个池塘里的每一个生物都需要干净的水。

ex.en: Respect for every human being should guide the development of public services and social welfare policies.
ex.zh: 对每个人的尊重都应成为公共服务和社会福利政策制定的指导原则。

tip: 指生物时可数；表示“存在”时通常不可数。

senses.en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful.
To think that something is likely or correct.
To have confidence or faith in someone or something.

ex.en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
ex.zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。

ex.en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者认为，在帮助学生为就业做准备方面，实践经验与学术知识同样重要。

tip: believe someone指相信其话；believe in someone指信任其能力。

senses.en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck
the ringing sound made by a bell

ex.en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
ex.zh: 一位骑车人靠近时，自行车铃响了。

ex.en: In many schools, a bell marks the beginning and end of each lesson.
ex.zh: 在许多学校，铃声标志着每节课的开始和结束。

tip: ring a bell也可表示“听着耳熟；似曾相识”。

senses.en: To be owned by someone
To have a proper place or category
To feel accepted as part of a group

ex.en: This blue umbrella belongs to my younger sister.
ex.zh: 这把蓝色雨伞是我妹妹的。

ex.en: Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.
ex.zh: 社区中心提供友好的空间，让新来者获得归属感并建立持久的友谊。

col: belong in a museum｜应放在博物馆
feel you belong｜感到有归属感
tip: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

senses.en: At a lower position, level, or amount than something.
In a lower place or later in a piece of writing.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
ex.zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。

ex.en: Households with incomes below the national average may struggle to afford adequate heating during winter.
ex.zh: 收入低于全国平均水平的家庭可能难以负担冬季充足供暖的费用。

tip: below强调位置或数值较低，不一定在正下方。

senses.en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes
a long area with a particular feature
a continuous strip that moves machinery or carries objects

ex.en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
ex.zh: 这条腰带能防止我的裤子往下滑。

ex.en: A green belt around a city can limit urban expansion and protect nearby farmland from development.
ex.zh: 城市周边的绿化带可以限制城市扩张，保护附近农田免遭开发。

tip: belt除腰带外也指带状区域，如green belt。

senses.en: At the side of someone or something.

ex.en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿靴子放在门旁边。

ex.en: Creating walking paths beside urban rivers can encourage physical activity and improve residents' access to nature.
ex.zh: 在城市河流旁修建步道可以鼓励身体活动，并让居民更容易亲近自然。

col: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip: beside表示“在旁边”；besides表示“此外；除……之外”。

senses.en: In addition to someone or something.
Used to add another fact or supporting reason.

ex.en: Besides apples, we need some bread and fresh milk.
ex.zh: 除了苹果，我们还需要一些面包和鲜奶。

ex.en: Besides reducing air pollution, investment in public transport can make cities more accessible to older residents.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通除了能减少空气污染，还能让老年居民在城市中出行更方便。

col: besides the fact that｜除了……这一事实之外
tip: besides表示额外包括；beside表示在旁边。

senses.en: Better than all others in quality or suitability.
In the most successful way or to the greatest degree.
The finest performance, effort, or thing available.

ex.en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店做的面包是我们街区最好的。

ex.en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
ex.zh: 投资早期教育可能是逐步减少不平等的最佳方式。

col: at its best｜处于最佳状态
tip: best是good和well的最高级；形容词前通常加the。

senses.en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.
In a more effective or satisfactory way.
Less ill than before.

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

ex.en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。

tip: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

senses.en: In the space or period separating people, things, or events.

senses.zh: 涉及双方或多方；由…共享
senses.en: Connecting distinct people or groups, or shared by them.
In the space or interval separating things.

ex.en: The cat squeezed between the sofa and the wall.
ex.zh: 猫从沙发和墙之间挤了过去。

ex.en: Cooperation between schools and local businesses can help students develop practical skills before entering employment.
ex.zh: 学校与当地企业的合作可以帮助学生在就业前培养实用技能。

col: between them｜由他们共同；在他们之间
tip: between不只限于两者，也可用于多个明确对象之间。

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals
to travel by bicycle

ex.en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
ex.zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。

ex.en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
ex.zh: 骑自行车出行既能减少城市空气污染，也能让居民经常锻炼身体。

tip: by bicycle不加冠词；ride a bicycle要加冠词。

senses.en: Large in size, amount, or degree.
Important or likely to have a strong effect.

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。

tip: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

senses.en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services
a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body
a piece of paper money, especially in American English

ex.en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
ex.zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员拿来账单。

ex.en: The proposed bill would require companies to disclose more information about their impact on the environment.
ex.zh: 这项拟议法案将要求企业披露更多有关其环境影响的信息。

col: a dollar bill｜一张美元钞票
tip: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。

senses.en: A container used for rubbish or for storing things.
To throw something away, especially into a rubbish container.

ex.en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 请把香蕉皮放进厨房的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.
ex.zh: 提供单独的厨余垃圾桶有助于家庭更有效地回收废物，并减少垃圾填埋量。

tip: “垃圾桶”英式常说bin，美式常说trash can。

senses.en: an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak that lays eggs

ex.en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟在我们窗户上方筑了巢。

ex.en: Protecting native bird species requires preserving their habitats and reducing pollution in both rural and urban areas.
ex.zh: 保护本土鸟类需要维护其栖息地，并减少乡村和城市地区的污染。

tip: 鸟群用a flock of birds；bird本身是可数名词。

senses.en: The yearly anniversary of the day someone was born.

ex.en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
ex.zh: 姐姐为我的生日烤了一个柠檬蛋糕。

ex.en: Although birthday celebrations vary across cultures, they often provide opportunities for families to spend time together.
ex.zh: 虽然不同文化中的生日庆祝方式各异，但它们往往能让家人有机会相聚。

tip: 在某人生日当天用on，不用in或at。

senses.en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet
a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast

ex.en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
ex.zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。

ex.en: Replacing sugary biscuits with fresh fruit can help children develop healthier eating habits over time.
ex.zh: 用新鲜水果代替高糖饼干，可以帮助儿童逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干
tip: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

senses.en: A small amount or piece of something.
The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.

ex.en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
ex.zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。

ex.en: Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 即使只有少量实践经验，也能帮助学生理解困难的科学概念。

tip: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

senses.en: To cut or grip with teeth, or wound with mouthparts
An act of biting, its wound, or a mouthful of food

ex.en: She bit into the apple and smiled at its sweetness.
ex.zh: 她咬了一口苹果，被甜得笑了起来。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should explain how travellers can prevent mosquito bites in regions with tropical diseases.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明，旅行者在热带疾病流行地区如何预防蚊虫叮咬。

tip: 过去式bit，过去分词bitten；一口用a bite。

senses.en: having the darkest colour, like coal
the darkest colour
relating to people with ancestry from sub-Saharan Africa

ex.en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
ex.zh: 她穿着黑色外套和亮黄色靴子。

ex.en: Black roofs absorb more sunlight than pale roofs, potentially increasing the energy needed for cooling.
ex.zh: 黑色屋顶比浅色屋顶吸收更多阳光，可能增加制冷所需的能源。

tip: 指族裔时常大写为Black；避免用作单数名词称人。

senses.en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.

ex.en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个大圆圈。

ex.en: Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.
ex.zh: 尽管电子屏幕具有互动功能，传统黑板仍是许多学校负担得起的教学工具。

col: write on the blackboard｜在黑板上书写
tip: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉笔使用。

senses.en: A thick bed covering, or a layer covering something.
Applying to everyone or everything without considering individual differences.
To cover something completely with a layer.

ex.en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她用一条柔软的毯子裹住冰凉的肩膀。

ex.en: A blanket ban on private vehicles may disadvantage residents who cannot easily access public transport.
ex.zh: 全面禁止私家车可能使难以使用公共交通的居民处于不利地位。

col: a blanket of snow｜厚厚的一层雪
tip: blanket作形容词指全面适用，如blanket ban。

senses.en: Unable to see.
Unwilling or unable to recognize facts or problems.
A window covering that can be raised or adjusted.

ex.en: My blind uncle reads stories using his fingertips.
ex.zh: 我失明的叔叔用指尖触读故事。

ex.en: Public transport systems should provide clear audio announcements to help blind passengers travel safely and independently.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统应提供清晰的语音播报，帮助失明乘客安全、独立地出行。

col: blind to the risks｜无视风险
tip: blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

senses.en: A solid piece of material with fairly flat sides.
To stop movement or prevent something from happening.
An area between streets, or a large building.

ex.en: The sculptor carved a bird from a block of wood.
ex.zh: 雕刻家用一块木头雕出了一只鸟。

ex.en: Poorly parked vehicles can block access to public buildings, creating difficulties for wheelchair users.
ex.zh: 停放不当的车辆可能堵住公共建筑的入口，给轮椅使用者带来困难。

col: a block of flats｜一栋公寓楼
a block of ice｜一大块冰
tip: a block of flats指公寓楼，是英式常用表达。

senses.en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body
family relationships or origins

ex.en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
ex.zh: 护士从我的手臂抽了一些血。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低血压，并减少患心脏病的风险。

tip: blood通常不可数；一次验血用a blood test。

senses.en: to move air, or move because of moving air
an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss
a hard hit with a hand or object

ex.en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
ex.zh: 一阵冷风把树叶吹过空荡荡的操场。

ex.en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
ex.zh: 当地工厂的关闭严重打击了该地区的就业机会。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
deal a blow to｜给……造成打击
tip: 动词变化为blow–blew–blown。

senses.en: having the colour of a clear daytime sky
the colour of a clear daytime sky
feeling sad or unhappy

ex.en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
ex.zh: 他穿了一件蓝色夹克去野餐。

ex.en: Urban designers often use blue surfaces to create a sense of calm in busy public spaces.
ex.zh: 城市设计师常使用蓝色的表面，在繁忙的公共空间营造宁静感。

tip: feel blue表示心情低落；颜色较浅用light blue。

senses.en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material.
A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions.
Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.

ex.en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
ex.zh: 她在泥泞的小路上横放了一块木板。

ex.en: The board approved a plan to reduce factory emissions without cutting jobs or lowering wages.
ex.zh: 董事会批准了一项在不裁员、不降薪的前提下减少工厂排放的计划。

tip: board作动词可直接接交通工具：board a train。

senses.en: a vessel for travelling on water, usually smaller than a ship

ex.en: We hired a small boat and explored the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，游览了湖面。

ex.en: In remote coastal communities, travelling by boat remains essential for accessing schools and medical services.
ex.zh: 在偏远的沿海社区，乘船出行仍是获得教育和医疗服务的重要方式。

tip: by boat不加冠词；on a boat表示在船上。

senses.en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
An organized group with a particular purpose.
The main or central part of something.

ex.en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很长一段路，现在我全身酸痛。

ex.en: An independent body should monitor water quality and publish its findings for the public.
ex.zh: 应由一个独立机构监测水质，并向公众公布调查结果。

col: a body of evidence｜一系列证据
the body of an essay｜文章正文
tip: body可指机构；文章的body指正文部分。

senses.en: to reach, or heat liquid until it reaches, bubbling temperature
to cook food in water that is bubbling from heat
a painful swollen lump in the skin containing pus

ex.en: Boil the potatoes until you can pierce them easily.
ex.zh: 把土豆煮到能轻松戳穿为止。

ex.en: Residents should boil drinking water when flooding has damaged local supplies and increased the risk of infection.
ex.zh: 当洪水破坏当地供水并增加感染风险时，居民应将饮用水煮沸。

tip: boil指沸腾或煮沸；simmer指小火慢煮。

senses.en: A set of pages joined together for reading
To arrange in advance to use a service or attend something

ex.en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把书落在厨房的桌子上了。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费借阅书籍的机会，让不同收入的人都能持续学习。

tip: book 作动词表示预订，可直接接房间、机票等。

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.

ex.en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
ex.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

ex.en: Students may find repetitive exercises boring unless teachers explain their purpose and introduce variety.
ex.zh: 如果教师不解释练习的目的并增加变化，学生可能会觉得重复练习很乏味。

col: find something boring｜觉得某事无聊
tip: boring指令人无聊；bored指人感到无聊。

senses.en: Brought into the world as a baby
Having a natural ability for a particular activity

ex.en: My little sister was born on a snowy morning.
ex.zh: 我的小妹妹出生在一个下雪的早晨。

ex.en: Children born in rural areas may face greater difficulties accessing specialist healthcare than those in cities.
ex.zh: 与城市儿童相比，出生在农村的儿童获得专科医疗服务可能更加困难。

col: be born into a family｜出生在某个家庭
a born leader｜天生的领导者
tip: 出生用be born；过去出生说was/were born。

senses.en: To take and use something with permission, then return it.
To use an idea or word from another source.

ex.en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?
ex.zh: 我能借用一下你的伞，明天早上还吗？

ex.en: Many languages borrow words from others as international trade and cultural exchange bring communities closer.
ex.zh: 随着国际贸易和文化交流拉近各群体的距离，许多语言会从其他语言中引入词汇。

tip: borrow是借入，lend是借出；向某人借用from。

senses.en: referring to two people or things together
the two people or things already mentioned

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
ex.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。

ex.en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。

tip: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ex.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
ex.zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。

col: reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子
tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

senses.en: The lowest part of something.
The part of your body that you sit on.
In the lowest position.

ex.en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙在包的最底下。

ex.en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
ex.zh: 废弃物经常堆积在河底，破坏栖息地并威胁水生生物。

col: from top to bottom｜从上到下
tip: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

senses.en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids
to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.
ex.zh: 用较小的碗盛饭可能有助于人们控制食量，减少不必要的食物浪费。

tip: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。

senses.en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid
to put something into a box
to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
ex.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
ex.zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。

col: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

senses.en: a male child or young male person

ex.en: The boy carefully carried his puppy across the puddle.
ex.zh: 那个男孩小心地抱着小狗跨过水坑。

ex.en: Every boy and girl should have equal access to education, regardless of their family's income.
ex.zh: 无论家庭收入如何，每个男孩和女孩都应享有平等的受教育机会。

col: a teenage boy｜十几岁的男孩
tip: 通常指未成年男性；称成年男性为boy可能不礼貌。

senses.en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity.
The ability to think clearly and understand things.

ex.en: A helmet helps protect your brain if you fall.
ex.zh: 跌倒时，头盔有助于保护你的大脑。

ex.en: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function and helps learners remember information more effectively.
ex.zh: 充足的睡眠有助于大脑正常运作，并帮助学习者更有效地记忆信息。

tip: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。

senses.en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.

ex.en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。

ex.en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
ex.zh: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。

col: brave enough to｜有足够勇气做
tip: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

senses.en: a food made from flour and water, usually baked

ex.en: Fresh bread was cooling beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 刚出炉的面包放在厨房窗边晾凉。

ex.en: Choosing wholegrain bread instead of refined varieties can increase fibre intake and support a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 选择全谷物面包而非精制面包，可以增加膳食纤维摄入，有助于均衡饮食。

col: a loaf of bread｜一条面包
a slice of bread｜一片面包
tip: bread通常不可数；一片用a slice of bread。

senses.en: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working.
A short period when an activity stops.
To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.

ex.en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
ex.zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。

ex.en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
ex.zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。

tip: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

senses.en: the meal you eat at the start of the day

ex.en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我通常吃完早餐再去坐公交车。

ex.en: Schools that provide a healthy breakfast may help students concentrate better during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 提供健康早餐的学校可能有助于学生在上午的课堂上更加专注。

col: a balanced breakfast｜营养均衡的早餐
tip: 泛指吃早餐用have breakfast，不加冠词。

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

ex.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。

ex.en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
ex.zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

col: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气
out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

senses.en: take air into your lungs and let it out

ex.en: Sit by the window and breathe slowly for a minute.
ex.zh: 坐在窗边，缓缓呼吸一分钟。

ex.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

senses.en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle.
To connect separated things or reduce differences between them.
A card game played by four people in two partnerships.

ex.en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
ex.zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。

ex.en: Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.
ex.zh: 社区语言项目可以弥合文化差异，帮助新来者更充分地参与当地生活。

tip: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

senses.en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour
quick to learn and understand things
promising success or showing happiness

ex.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，明亮的阳光从厨房窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
ex.zh: 无论家庭背景如何，获得优质教育都能让年轻人拥有光明的未来。

tip: 形容光线强用bright；形容房间暗用dim。

senses.en: to carry someone or something to a place
to cause a situation, feeling, or result

ex.en: Please bring a warm coat when you visit.
ex.zh: 你来时请带一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Improved public transport can bring significant benefits to residents who cannot afford their own cars.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能为买不起私家车的居民带来显著益处。

col: bring someone something｜给某人带来某物
tip: bring强调带到说话者或指定地点；过去式brought。

senses.en: To transmit programmes through radio, television, or the internet.
A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The station broadcasts local news every morning before breakfast.
ex.zh: 这家电台每天早晨早餐前播报本地新闻。

ex.en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
ex.zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

senses.en: A male who has one or both parents in common with you.

ex.en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
ex.zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的自行车。

ex.en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
ex.zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通过经常在家陪弟弟妹妹阅读来帮助他们学习。

tip: brother不区分兄弟；用older或younger说明长幼。

senses.en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood.
The colour of chocolate or dark wood.
To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.

ex.en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
ex.zh: 一只棕色的小狗正在门边睡觉。

ex.en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
ex.zh: 在干旱时期，植物为了保存水分会减缓生长，草也常因此变成褐色。

tip: brown作动词常用于烹饪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。
